description: This file is a React component for a Next.js application, specifically the main App component for a career navigator interface. It manages the user interface for uploading documents, generating and managing persona data, orchestrating backend build processes, and displaying progress/status. It utilizes React hooks for state management, API calls for backend interactions, and includes UI elements for file uploads, persona visualization, and workflow steps.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array, filtering out non-string elements.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials of a label for avatar display, e.g., 'John Doe' -> 'JD'.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested properties in an object given a path array, returning the value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs available keys in an object for debugging the shape of orchestration payloads.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from orchestration response based on various candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData structure, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the career persona creation workflow including uploads, orchestration, and UI state.
